title: Stratos BLITZ ARENA
one_line: A fast 6v6 team shooter with two modes: hold the moving hill or first to 30 kills, in about three minutes.
how_to_play: Move with WASD and aim with the mouse (or the touch sticks on a phone), fire to shoot, and stand on the glowing hill to score for your team.
description:
Stratos Blitz Arena is a fast, blocky 6v6 team shooter made for short matches. There are two modes, both about three minutes long. In Hardpoint a glowing hill appears on the map and your team scores while you stand on it. Every minute the hill moves, so you keep running and fighting. In Team Deathmatch there is no hill: every kill scores for your team, and the first team to 30 kills wins.

Before a match you pick your loadout in a few taps: two weapons and two abilities, like a dash or a shield. Every weapon feels different, from a steady assault rifle to a quick SMG, and each has its own recoil and range. If you have no friends online, do not worry. Bots fill every empty slot, so a match starts in under ten seconds and you are never waiting around.

Between matches you earn XP and Stratos Coins, finish three new daily challenges and unlock skins for your weapons and your look. It works with a mouse and keyboard on a computer, and with touch controls on a phone held sideways, with a little aim assist to help your thumbs. The whole game is small, loads fast and needs no sign-up.
controls: Move: WASD. Look: mouse (click Play to lock the pointer). Fire: left click. Aim: right click.
Reload: R. Jump: Space. Sprint: Shift. Switch weapon: 1 and 2. Abilities: Q and E.
Phone: hold it sideways. Left thumb moves, right thumb looks, and the buttons fire, aim, jump and reload.
tips: Stay near the glowing hill and fight for it, because only the team standing on it scores.
Use your dash or shield ability to escape or to win a close fight.
Do the daily challenges for extra XP and coins.

resume.why: A match is a quick three-minute Hardpoint round, so a half-finished match is not worth resuming. XP, level, coins, skins and daily challenges are saved on this device.

coins.why: The game has its own skins shop paid with its own coins. Stratos Coins are paid automatically from level_start and game_over, and are not spent in the game yet.
